description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among all requests. ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, **ClientToken** is set to the value of **RequestId**. The value of **RequestId** for each API request may be different.

description.zh:
HaVip的描述。

描述长度为1～255个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The description of the HaVip.

The description must be 1 to 255 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
HaVip的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The name of the HaVip.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
HaVip所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region to which the HaVip belongs.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

descriptions.zh: **ModifyHaVipAttribute**不支持并发修改同一个HaVip的名称和描述。
descriptions.en: **ModifyHaVipAttribute**不支持并发修改同一个HaVip的名称和描述。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc modify-ha-vip-attribute --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-0016e00000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ha-vip-id havip-2zeo05qre24nhrqp0000 --description This_is_my_HaVip. --name test --region cn-hangzhou
